text: Fixed on main at b8ac3eb (commits de75da4, f8e6068, b8ac3eb). The cause is in the Scala.js emitter (SJSGen.genIsInstanceOfClass), not the optimizer. It folds isInstanceOf against a class with no instances in the linked program to false and drops the tested expression, side effects included. The inlined exists put it.next() inside that expression, so the loop never advanced. Reproduced on Scala.js 1.19.0 through 1.22.0, Scala 3.3.8 and 2.13.18. 1) Workaround: LayoutPhase.containsEcdfRow, an index loop. Reduced repro in tools/scalajs-instanceof-repro (run.sh); draft upstream text in UPSTREAM-REPORT.md there, NOT filed. 2) Gate: tools/check-fulllink.sh links modules/fulllink-smoke with fullLinkJS and runs 6 plot compiles + Canvas paints in Node with a timeout. Exit 124 at de75da4 (hang); exit 0 at f8e6068 and at b8ac3eb on main. CI step added in the 3.3.8/JDK17 cell; not yet run on hosted CI. 3) Budget decision in docs/performance.md: keep budgets on fastLinkJS; run the performance page once on fullLinkJS at release rehearsal for its assertions only. One run each: 54/54 budgets pass on both bundles. The only other candidate site (CanvasRenderer.drawChecked count) is not reachable. Evidence: .agent-work/fulllink-hang/README.md (untracked).
